text:
mika: quick heads-up from sentinel-small onboard: ran rotate-kvcache + q5-fast and seeing em-dash / narrow no-break-space (U+202F) reattachment + punctuation drift in mixed JP/AR inputs. small repro and numbers below.

raj: can you paste a tiny example & commit? which kernel/quant profile?

mika: commit 7c9e21d (kvcache/rotate-refine), kernel v5.6.0, quant q5-fast. sample diff: baseline (flat,q8) BLEU=33.0 -> rotate+q5 BLEU=24.2.

leo: example pls.

mika: ```
# input: "日本語 — التسجيل الاسسي (אב) ."  # mixed JP + AR + hebrew, includes NNBSP (U+202F) before paren
# baseline out: "Japanese — the effort of Al-Assi (Av)."
# experiment out: "Japanese — the effort of Al-Assi )Av (."
# notes: closing paren moved outside, NNBSP glued to hebrew fragment and mirrored paren, em-dash spacing collapsed near CJK boundary
```

sara: interesting: NNBSP & em-dash combined with rotate fingerprint seems to change prefix alignment; quant q5-fast's different fp path nudges logits so punctuation token selection flips.

mika: repro command I used: `python eval_onboard.py --model sentinel-small --kernel v5.6.0 --quant q5-fast --cache rotate --input tests/mixed_jp_ar_he.txt --metrics bleu,paired_punct_preserve --save-outputs /tmp/sentinel_bug`

triage-bot: upload complete -> gs://redwood-evals/sentinel/6377777777_bundle.zip (110 examples, detok scripts, token-diff.csv)

raj: did factor isolation: rotate-only (q8) BLEU=30.2, quant-only (flat) BLEU=26.1, combined BLEU=24.2. so both factors degrade, combined worst.

leo: immediate mitigation: add heuristic to skip rotate when NNBSP or U+200D (ZWJ) co-occur with CJK and strong-RTL char ranges; small canary toggle. also add paired-punctuation assertion to onboarding smoke (owner: sara).

ops-bot: canary patch queued -> disable-rotate-nnbsps (rollout: canary 2 nodes)

sara: long-term: add directional/context bit + NNBSP-aware normalization into kvcache fingerprint and add fuzz tests combining em-dash, NNBSP, ZWJ, RLM, LRM with CJK. also instrument detok pairing diffs in eval outputs for every onboard run.

mika: opened issue R-INF-2388 with repro + bucket links and tagged @eng-runtime @quant-team.

raj: i'll pick up the fingerprint normalization RFC and prototype. leo: can you own the canary rollback plan if needed?

leo: yes. will also message Dedicated beta channel about temporary toggle.

mika: thanks all. will post PR link when ready. :white_check_mark:
